library(QnaSut)

## Créer / mettre à jour le fichier persistant

```{r}
# Adapter root_dir si besoin (répertoire OutilCntBfa)
root_dir <- "C:/CnaBfaScn08/CntBfaV4/07P_Outils/OutilCntBfa"

path_excel <- file.path(root_dir, "Methode_ERE.xlsx")
path_rds <- sauvegarder_modele_equilibrage_ere(
  path_excel = path_excel,
  output_dir = root_dir,
  output_file = "Modele_Equilibrage_ERE.rds",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

path_rds
```

## Charger dans le pipeline principal

```{r}
modele_equilibrage <- charger_modele_equilibrage_ere(
  file.path(root_dir, "Modele_Equilibrage_ERE.rds")
)

str(modele_equilibrage, max.level = 1)
```
